participant_1.name: Kate
participant_1.personality: Optimistic and adventurous, Kate loves exploring nature and is passionate about hiking.
participant_1.background: My favorite color is orange. I just broke up with my boyfriend two months ago. I turned 18 years old yesterday. I like to go hiking in the mornings to see the sunset. I have a pet fish.

participant_2.name: Jordan
participant_2.personality: Thoughtful and slightly cynical, Jordan is trying to make the best of his situation while feeling the weight of expectations.
participant_2.background: They are constantly on my back. I do not drink or do drugs or anything. I am 19 and I cannot wait to move out of my parents' home. I work; I have a part-time job at Burger King.
